quote.text: If men were angels, no government would be necessary. If angels were to govern men, neither external nor internal controls on government would be necessary.
quote.author: James Madison, The Federalist No. 51 (1788)

stories.headline: Wong says Singapore cannot police AI chips shipped elsewhere
stories.dek: Speaking in Beijing on 21 November, the prime minister offered Washington information instead; police and Customs have investigated the cloud firm Megaspeed since February 2025.

stories.headline: Pink-gold Patek Philippe 1518 makes HK$25.1 million at Phillips
stories.dek: Lot 1065, a 1951 watch with a Spanish calendar, sold on 22 November at three times its HK$8 million low estimate; the platinum 3990P-011 scraped past its low at HK$12.7 million.

stories.headline: AI exam cheating topples South Korea’s education minister
stories.dek: A tax-exam top scorer’s confession on 15 November put stickers on the buttons of 551,864 Suneung candidates — and ended Choi Kyo-jin’s tenure on 22 November.

stories.headline: COP31 collapses in Antalya without a deal on fossil fuels
stories.dek: The EU vetoed a text with no fossil-fuel wording on 22 November; it is the first climate summit since Copenhagen in 2009 to end with no overall decision.

stories.headline: India’s Kolhapuri rules demand bark-tanned leather sewn with leather thread
stories.dek: India’s 2018 filing covers eight districts of Maharashtra and Karnataka and fixes a 30–32-day bark tan; a pair from the state agency LIDCOM lists at ₹1,231.

stories.kicker: Technology · China’s Hunt For Nvidia Chips
stories.headline: China’s spy ministry ran a two-year hunt for Nvidia chips
stories.dek: Minister Chen Yixin set up a team that answers only to him, the New York Times reported on 21 November; in Singapore, a defendant linked to Megaspeed’s former chief, Li Ming, 52, is out on bail.

stories.headline: Xreal ships Aura, the first glasses built for Google’s Android XR
stories.dek: Engadget’s 18 November review scores the US$1,279 Aura seven out of ten; Xreal sells it in the US, Canada, Japan and South Korea first.

stories.kicker: Screen & Sound · Sunrise on the Reaping
stories.headline: Sunrise on the Reaping opens to $120 million in North America
stories.dek: The studio’s Sunday estimate adds $105 million from 84 territories outside North America for $225 million worldwide, the series’ best home start since 2014.

stories.kicker: Raising Them Well · Head Scans And Risk
stories.headline: JAMA study links childhood head CT scans to rare brain tumours
stories.dek: Diana Miglioretti’s team followed 3.7 million children in six US health systems and Ontario: about one extra tumour for every 1,266 head scans, published 19 November.

stories.kicker: The Macro Desk · The Plumbing Held
stories.headline: Federal Reserve data show US money markets held through the sell-off
stories.dek: Banks’ reserves at the Federal Reserve rose $19 billion to $3.0 trillion in the week to 18 November, and the overnight lending rate SOFR ended Thursday at 3.91 per cent.

stories.headline: Brattleboro Museum hangs the Mokuhanga Sisters’ Japanese woodblock prints
stories.dek: The nine-artist show opened on 14 November and runs to 6 March 2027; entries for the 2027 mokuhanga conference’s juried show in Lawrence, Kansas, close on 30 November.

stories.headline: Cooper Institute links midlife fitness to fewer lung and bowel cancers
stories.dek: Clare Meernik’s team followed 28,612 Dallas men into old age; fitter men also lived longer after diagnosis, Medicine & Science in Sports & Exercise reported on 17 November.

stories.kicker: The Diary · Nutcracker, Clockenflap And Comic Con
stories.headline: Singapore Ballet stages The Nutcracker at the Esplanade from 9 December
stories.dek: Seven performances run to 13 December at S$45–110; in Hong Kong, Clockenflap puts Hayley Williams and Turnstile on the harbourfront from 4 December.
